links.comparator_used: Same scenarios without the short mitigation cue (no instruction to verify or escalate if unsafe), under a neutral control and six social-pressure conditions
links.outcome: Proportion of potentially harmful outputs (selection or endorsement of an unsafe clinical decision)
links.effect: Overall 16.6% unmitigated vs 10.1% mitigated (absolute reduction 6.5 percentage points; p < 0.001). Synthetic vignettes 10.6% to 7.2% (3.4 points). Real-world discharge cases 46.6% to 24.5% (22.1 points).
links.quote: Harmful decisions occurred in 16.6% of unmitigated versus 10.1% of mitigated conditions (absolute reduction, 6.5 percentage points; p < 0.001).
